CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

3. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

12. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. C — Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
